headline: Tech spending is expanding across most sectors while revenue trends vary.
summary: Media & Entertainment shows strong revenue growth at Disney and Versant, but WBD/Skydance faces a revenue decline. Gaming & Lottery mixes positive momentum at Bally's with weaker results at Caesars and modest growth at Light & Wonder. Publishing & Information is mixed, with Pearson posting growth and Scholastic missing revenue. Education sees steady performance at Pearson and research grants at NYU and SLU.

industries.summary: Disney reported Q3 revenue of $25,248 million, up 7% YoY, and operating income up 21%. Versant posted $1,644 million revenue with a 22.3% margin. WBD/Skydance saw revenue of $6,913 million decline 13.4% YoY.

leaders.why: Revenue up 7% and operating income up 21%.

themes.title: AI & tech investment
themes.detail: Disney bid $20 million for AI startup assets; Cox integrated AI platform after its $34.5 billion acquisition.

themes.title: Digital platform rebuild
themes.detail: Paramount+ and Pluto TV unified tech stack; Versant expanded Fandango and direct‑to‑consumer tools.

industries.it_note: Account teams should highlight AI integration opportunities and platform consolidation benefits.

industries.summary: Bally's achieved 20% revenue growth to $792 million with a negative margin of -4.3%. Caesars posted $2,993 million revenue but a net loss. Light & Wonder reported $828 million revenue with a strong 26.9% margin.

themes.title: M&A and automation
themes.detail: Bally's acquired evoke plc and launched automation in North America Interactive.

themes.title: Vendor outsourcing
themes.detail: Bally's signed new lottery technology contracts in multiple regions.

industries.it_note: Focus on how automation and new vendor contracts can improve profitability despite margin pressure.

industries.summary: Pearson grew revenue 4% to $1,779 million and raised operating profit 14%. Scholastic missed revenue at $216.8 million and posted a -42.5% margin. Wolters Kluwer had no data.

leaders.why: Revenue growth and higher operating profit.

laggards.why: Revenue miss and large operating loss.

themes.title: AI partnerships and acquisitions
themes.detail: Pearson signed AI lab and Adobe agreements and bought Workera.

themes.title: Strategic acquisition
themes.detail: Scholastic bought Cottage Door Press for $71 million.

industries.it_note: Highlight Pearson's AI‑enabled learning initiatives as a growth lever.

industries.summary: Pearson repeats its 4% revenue growth. NYU received a $3.3 million NIH grant for a digital PCR platform. SLU partnered with World Wide Technology for AI collaboration.

themes.title: Research and AI collaboration
themes.detail: NYU and SLU are expanding AI and digital health capabilities through grants and vendor partnerships.

industries.it_note: Account teams should monitor university AI projects for future partnership pipelines.
